_source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fishing_Trawler and /Strategies (rules, points, rewards); a normal-world capture of a full trip on the official Trawler world (leak batches, tentacle and rail values and timings, the timer, messages, the sailing interfaces); the cache for every id. Values neither gives are marked _calibrated.

lobby._note: the docked trawler's deck at Port Khazard

boat._note: the dry trawler copy; its leaks are on the lower deck (plane 0)

_shore: 2672,3209 is open sea in the cache (overlay 442); 2658,3210 is the nearest coast tile, on the shore north of Port Khazard below the DJP fairy ring.

timing._calibrated: water per open leak, a bail's water, the random net rip, how long an unchopped tentacle stays, and the chops it takes
timing._leaks: leakBatchMin/Max: the spots leaking after each 5-tick batch (the capture's 6-11 of 16)

catch._calibrated: per-player base fish per catching tick: about 14 for a solo trip with some downtime, falling with crew size towards the Wiki's 13-15 for full groups at a full meter
catch._tiers: each fish tries the highest tier the player can catch first, then the next one down: about 0.67 lobster at 40 and 0.21 at 50 once swordfish appears (the Wiki's chart)

messages.boardBusy: A trawler is already at sea. You will leave on the next one.
messages.depart: You set sail on the trawler.
messages.noPaste: You need some swamp paste to fill the leak.
messages.filled: You fill the leak with swamp paste.
messages.noBucketWater: There isn't enough water here to bail.
messages.bailed: You bail some water from the ship.
messages.emptied: You empty the bucket over the side.
messages.netFailed: You fail to repair the net in the harsh conditions.
messages.netFine: The net is in good condition.
messages.chopFail: You swing at the tentacle but miss.
messages.chopDrove: The tentacle retreats into the sea.
messages.noAxe:
You need an axe to chop down this tentacle.
You do not have an axe which you have the woodcutting level to use.
messages.noHammer: You need a hammer to fix the rail.
messages.sunk: The trawler has sunk. Climb onto a barrel to get back to shore.
messages.swim: You climb onto the barrel and drift back to shore.
messages.tooLittle: You didn't help enough to earn a share of the catch.
messages.lowLevel: You need a Fishing level of 15 to receive a share of the catch.
messages.collected: You collect your catch from the net. It is sent to your bank.
messages.bankFull: Your bank is too full to hold all of your catch. The rest stays in the net.
messages.rewardWaiting: <col=ef1020>You have a catch waiting in the trawler net. It will be thrown back if you sail again.</col>
messages.destroyedReward: Your uncollected catch from the last trip has been thrown back.
messages._angler: Wiki (Fishing Trawler, trivia): the angler-piece message.
messages.angler: The luck of the sea is in today. You spot a piece of fishing gear caught up in the netting!
messages.krakenRipped: The Kraken has ripped the net!
messages.earned: You have helped enough to earn a portion of the catch.
messages.contributed: You have contributed enough to earn rewards! Contribution:{points}/{max}
messages.summary: Nets fixed:<col=ff0000>{nets}</col> Leaks patched:<col=ff0000>{leaks}</col> Water bailed:<col=ff0000>{bailed}</col> Tentacles hacked and railings fixed:<col=ff0000>{tentacles}</col>.
messages.toShore: Murphy turns the boat towards shore.

_messages: Captured live: departIn, netRipped, krakenRipped, kraken, noAxe, earned, contributed, summary, toShore. Every other message here is unverified.
